contract:
Unprofiled whole-transformer screening of a production aligned-grid runtime.

Full numerical outputs are qualified separately. Timed calls check result shape,
owned-resource cleanup and submission counts, not a numerical checksum. This is
timing evidence; pair it with the production CTest qualification record.
validation_scope: Separate 117 full-output cases with independent oracle; timed invocations check shape, resource cleanup and command count. No value-derived timing checksum.
